Academic History & Transcripts

Select Add Institution and upload transcripts from all institutions of higher education where you enrolled in college-level coursework. This includes vocational, two-year, and four-year institutions.

Unofficial transcripts can be submitted with your application and used for admission consideration. Admitted applicants will be required to submit final official transcripts from their baccalaureate institution. In some cases, final official transcripts from all degree-awarding institutions are required as a condition of admission.

To be accepted, your unofficial transcript must:

Display the exact phrase “Unofficial Transcript.”
Show your full official university name (e.g., “University of California Los Angeles,” not “UCLA”).
Not accepted: “Academic Record,” “DARS,” “Degree Audit,” “Progress Report,” or documents without the university name.

Select Edit next to each institution to upload or replace a transcript.
